title:
A family owned DMC
sharing the Georgia we love
intro: At Locate Georgia, we create journeys that go beyond sightseeing. Our mission is to immerse travelers in the real spirit of Georgia — its people, flavors, landscapes, and traditions. We design culturally rich experiences that let you live, eat, and explore like a local, turning every trip into a meaningful, unforgettable adventure.
story:
Locate Georgia is a family-owned tour agency located in the heart of Tbilisi, Georgia! Our agency was founded in 2017 by a team of professionals who have been working in the tourism industry for over 15 years. With a deep understanding of the local culture and a passion for sharing the beauty of our country with others, we have built a reputation for providing high-quality, personalized tours that showcase the best of Georgia.

At our agency, we believe that every traveler deserves a unique and authentic experience. That's why we specialize in creating customized tours that cater to the interests and preferences of each individual or group.

As a family-owned business, we take pride in providing personalized, friendly service to each and every one of our clients. When you book a tour with us, you can rest assured that you'll receive the highest level of attention and care from our team.

We look forward to welcoming you to our beautiful country and showing you all that it has to offer!

Happy Holidays!

values_title: What you can expect from us

values.title: Local knowledge
values.text: We were born here. Our guides and coordinators share the places, stories and people they know personally.

values.title: Journeys made for you
values.text: Private or group, five days or two weeks: every itinerary is built around your pace, interests and budget.

values.title: Personal care
values.text: One team looks after you from the first message to the airport farewell, and we are reachable day and night.

values.title: Honest partners
values.text: We work with trusted hotels, drivers, wineries and families across Georgia, many of them for years.
